content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 establishes that CPT 93271 is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable; there is no coding, authorization, eligibility, or COB defect to correct. Resubmitting unchanged risks a duplicate denial, while medical-necessity appeals and peer-to-peer reviews have produced no payment on similar claims and do not address bundling. Because this contractual denial creates no collectible patient balance and there is no secondary payer, the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
